instruction: Access the pill identification tool on Drugs.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the drugs.com homepage to the pill identifier tool page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active URL matches the expected pill identifier page. This is a simple navigation task similar in complexity to the original natural products database navigation.
metadata.verification_notes: The pill identifier (imprints.php) is a standard tool on drugs.com for identifying pills by their markings. Task requires agent to find and navigate to this tool from the homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree
Metric logic correctly compares actual URL with expected URL using compare_urls function
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (navigating to pill identifier page)
Expected value is semantically correct: https://www.drugs.com/imprints.php is the actual URL for Drugs.com pill identifier tool
Data flow is correct: getter returns URL string, metric receives and compares it appropriately
Runtime feasibility confirmed: accessibility tree is available after task execution, no state timing issues
